coverage: Frozen snapshot warmup [2020-01-01,2020-02-03) and IS [2020-02-03,2024-07-01); no later row read.

features.source: https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/monthly/klines/<symbol>/8h/<symbol>-8h-YYYY-MM.zip (daily path substitutes daily and YYYY-MM-DD); snapshot bars.parquet
features.lag: latest input bar opens t-8h; order fills at hidden open t
features.transformation: scale-free true-range wick/body q; 12-slot median and sign persistence. Adjacent returns are log(C_k/C_{k-1}); r24/r7d sum 3/21 contiguous returns. Beta is sum((r_i-mean_i)*(r_BTC-mean_BTC))/sum((r_BTC-mean_BTC)^2), with both means on aligned pairs in the last 63 scheduled slots.
features.minimum: 9/12 q; all 3 r24 and 21 r7d returns; 18/21 volatility; 50 aligned beta pairs and BTC mean squared deviation >1e-12; exact 8h adjacency
features.missing: invalidate affected observation; flat if BTC unavailable or fewer than 10 valid names

features.source: same Binance transaction-kline archive and bars.parquet
features.transformation: log of 21-slot median; also central prior-24h participation capacity
features.minimum: 18/21 feature slots; central cap always authoritative
features.missing: symbol invalid for signal; never imputed

features.source: https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/monthly/fundingRate/<symbol>/<symbol>-fundingRate-YYYY-MM.zip; manifest-frozen gap fallback https://fapi.binance.com/fapi/v1/fundingRate; mark fallback https://fapi.binance.com/fapi/v1/markPriceKlines; funding.parquet
features.transformation: raw rate robust-z nuisance and neutralization constraint; actual evaluator cashflow uses frozen mark_price
features.missing: rate=0 plus missing indicator; cashflows never synthesized

features.source: membership.parquet derived PIT from Binance quote volume and https://fapi.binance.com/fapi/v1/exchangeInfo
features.available_timestamp: decision t at or after reconstitution
features.missing: not tradable; central capped exit if previously held

cross_sectional_fit: Contemporaneous median/MAD and pseudoinverse use only rows available at t; no state is prefit across time.
label: log transaction open(t+8h)/open(t), used only after its end in IS validation
